_doc: Fixtures for .harmony/probe-render-state.sh (s-rta-0926b render lanes: R5 wave 1; R1 render2; A4 / P bf9 Stage P, which retired the R2 / R4 persistent-layer fixtures). @MEDIA@ is replaced at run time with the checkout's media/ dir. Effects are [name, param...]. Thresholds and calibration: docstring of .harmony/probe-render-state.py.

r5_hold._why: layer id 91 (fresh this run), col 0 = A, col 1 = A + [Screen Split, Freeze 1.0]. Freeze 1.0 outputs its history; a fresh history is cleared to transparent black. Creating it INSIDE the Freeze pass left the pass target holding only its glClear (Screen Split's grey) and that became the held history

r5_burst._why: fresh layer ids, col 0 = A, col 1 = A + [Freeze 0.5]; back-to-back captures across the switch. No frame after the switch may be blank (the creation frame used to be fully transparent)
r5_burst._postSwitchS: seconds of back-to-back captures after the switch; 2.0 holds >= 8 full-canvas (1920x1080) captures (was 0.6 s before plan4: 6-7)

r1._why: one layer, OUT = col 0 = A + out, IN = col 1 = B + in, Wipe Left over T s: each region must show ONLY its own clip (ratio vs that clip alone <= bound). Ruling R1 = B': outgoing slot, copy buffer / swap ring

counts._why: fresh layer id, 6 cols alternating A/B each with fx, faded through with T s: exactly +2 frame rings (the layer's + its outgoing slot). peakMaxMs bars the layer's first use AND its first fade: one 60 Hz frame period: a hitch under it cannot drop a frame; RED on 1636785 35.5-38.5 ms (routines-timing T2), GREEN expected <= 6 ms (the 2nd fade's 1.2-5.9 ms = the same work without creation) -- s-rta-0927 plan-renderperf C1 (frame-ring cells created on first write)

cells._why: s-rta-0928 R5 (C4): /api/state frame_ring_cells counts ring cells created so far; a fresh ring grows by at most one cell per frame and never past 480

a4._why: bf9 Stage P (ruling-bf9 amendment 12(b)): active-deck stages no other probe covers once the r4_* persistent rows were retired. Deck 0 only: layer 0 Opaque A, plus layer id 5 = a Transparent B with the feedback values (a4_feedback) | type 2 FX Only with the media-less fx clip (a4_fxonly) | type 1 Transparent with the media-less fx clip (a4_fxonly_medialess)

p_flag._why: bf9 Stage P (ruling-bf9 amendment 12(c)): a file's "persistent": true is ignored -- deck 1's layer id 5 (Transparent, clip B covering the frame) never draws while deck 0 is shown. lock = render_frame width/height for p_flag_ignored_empty (moved from the retired r4_empty_active_deck)
